messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up: we are publishing the On-Prem Telemetry Opt-In guidance and a lightweight opt-in SDK today. This is for customers who want minimal usage telemetry for performance/ops while keeping data in their VPC. Docs: https://redwood.internal/onprem/telemetry-opt-in (internal).

ops-bot: Deploy checklist: docs pushed to staging, agent image built: redwood/agent:onprem-telemetry-v1, e2e smoke started.

elaine: TL;DR for GTM/support: default behavior remains telemetry OFF. Customers can enable opt-in telemetry; we will never enable remotely. Sales & SEs — if a customer asks for metrics during onboarding, point them to the consent flow and this KB.

andre: What specifically counts as "minimal usage telemetry"? I want a clear list for SOC reviews.

kira: From the doc: aggregated cpu/memory, model invocation counts (no prompt/response content), agent health pings (timestamp + instance id hash), and anonymized error codes. We added explicit examples in the KB.

legal-team: Confirming: no customer payloads, no logs with PII, no prompts. All hashes use platform salt and are irreversible. We recommend adding this to the customer contract addendum; template available in the KB.

samir: Ops note: to toggle locally on an existing agent use:
```
redwood-agent config set telemetry.enabled true
redwood-agent config set telemetry.collection_level minimal
```
for disabling:
```
redwood-agent config set telemetry.enabled false
```
Also new agent prints a clear banner at startup when telemetry is enabled.

elaine: Rollout plan: today -> docs + SDK release; this week -> internal enablement (support playbook, canned responses); next week -> trial with 3 pilot customers. Please do NOT proactively offer telemetry to customers until SEs have completed the enablement checklist.

andre: Who owns the pilot coordination and the security questionnaire answers?

kira: I'll own pilot coordination. File onboarding notes to /eng-privacy/onprem-pilots and tag me. For security questionnaires we'll provide a redacted summary + legal-approved wording.

samir: Added short-runbook to the KB for diagnosing telemetry ingestion issues and how to escalate to infra.

elaine: Action items:
- SEs/sales: read the KB and use the contract addendum (legal-team)
- Support: internal playbook + canned replies (support)
- Eng-Infra: monitor pilot metrics and failover (samir)
- Legal: publish addendum template (legal-team)

kira: Thanks all. Ping me for pilot invites. :white_check_mark:

andre: Noted. :thumbsup:
__notes: Internal Slack thread announcing on-prem telemetry opt-in guidance and opt-in SDK. Root message + replies.
